title: Proposed normalized supplemental hardware records; no measured records are supplied
description: Private runtime adapter must retain original primitive logs and provide a hash-bound field map. This schema is an implementation contract, not a claim that all fields already exist in the private runtime. Use null with explicit reasons, preserve clock domains, and retain every attempt.

campaign_id.description: Fresh supplemental campaign, never a frozen campaign ID.

session_id.description: Fresh physical complete-block identity; a scheduling seed is not a session.

attempt_id.description: Unique physical attempt; retain unsuccessful attempts.

condition_id.description: Exact condition ID from the frozen plan.

event_id.description: Unique occurrence, independent of representation/source-sample repetition.

generation_round.description: Original round; background may precede measured round zero.

source_sample_id.description: Controlled source identifier; keep private when redistribution is restricted.

admitted_action.description: Final action; rejected remote work remains a generated event.

payload_bytes.description: Actual encoded application payload, including declared padding.

payload_sha256.description: Hash of actual serialized payload; null only when no payload exists.

origin_host_id.description: Stable originating host identity, not a public IP address.

origin_clock_id.description: Origin monotonic clock identity including reboot/epoch identity.

core_clock_id.description: Core monotonic clock identity including reboot/epoch identity.

scheduled_release_origin_ns.description: Nominal release in originating probe monotonic clock.

actual_event_creation_origin_ns.description: Primary deadline anchor on originating probe clock.

detector_start_origin_ns.description: Detector stage on originating probe clock.

detector_end_origin_ns.description: Detector stage on same originating probe clock.

preprocess_start_origin_ns.description: Preprocessing stage on originating probe clock; overlap if real is retained.

preprocess_end_origin_ns.description: Preprocessing stage on originating probe clock.

network_enqueue_origin_ns.description: Payload enqueue on originating probe clock.

payload_submit_start_origin_ns.description: Transport submission begins on originating probe clock.

payload_submit_end_origin_ns.description: Local transport submission completes; NOT necessarily remote receipt.

evidence_ack_received_origin_ns.description: Explicit complete-evidence acknowledgement received on originating clock; null if protocol has no such ACK.

core_payload_ready_core_ns.description: Complete evidence available on core clock, never subtracted from an origin timestamp.

core_enqueue_core_ns.description: Core inference queue entry on core clock.

core_start_core_ns.description: Actual inference starts on core clock.

core_end_core_ns.description: Actual inference ends on core clock.

core_result_send_core_ns.description: Result handed to transport on core clock.

result_received_origin_ns.description: Matched result received at originating probe; authoritative result deadline endpoint.

observed_through_origin_ns.description: Last trustworthy follow-up instant on originating clock.

deadline_matured.description: Derived from observed_through >= actual_creation + deadline, not guessed from missing results.

missing_timestamp_reasons.description: Every null timestamp has a reason, e.g. not_applicable, not_instrumented, missing_capture, pending; never substitute zero.

prediction.description: Actual final admitted execution output; remote and local endpoints must remain distinguishable.

ground_truth.description: Authorized label if available; not a runtime decision input.

queued_remaining_bytes.description: Remaining queued application bytes at retained observation end.

inflight_remaining_bytes.description: Remaining in-flight unique application bytes at observation end.

discarded_payload_bytes.description: Explicit cancelled/discarded bytes; never silently erased.

items.description: Reference into retained immutable primitive source records.

session_id.description: Fresh physical complete-block identity; a scheduling seed is not a session.

attempt_id.description: Unique physical attempt; retain unsuccessful attempts.

condition_id.description: Exact condition ID from the frozen plan.

service_round_index.description: Service period identity, separately from event origin round.

service_host_id.description: Host that records this service accounting boundary.

service_clock_id.description: Clock identity for the service boundary; do not compare with probe clocks without alignment proof.

service_end_ns.description: Round end on same service clock.

queue_before_bytes.description: Queued bytes immediately before new admissions in this service period.

new_admitted_bytes.description: Actually enqueued new bytes in this service period.

cancelled_from_queue_bytes.description: Explicit queue removals other than service.

service_granted_bytes.description: Allocator grant, retained separately from actual service.

actual_unique_application_service_bytes.description: Actual charged unique payload bytes from the transport/queue data path; reconstruct from primitive chunk records, not a cap-violation flag.

queue_after_bytes.description: Queue after admission, cancellation and actual service.

initial_state_fixture_id.description: Identifies predeclared initial backlog fixture only when applied.

session_id.description: Fresh physical complete-block identity; a scheduling seed is not a session.

attempt_id.description: Unique physical attempt; retain unsuccessful attempts.

condition_id.description: Exact condition ID from the frozen plan.

chunk_id.description: Unique raw transport accounting record, not reconstructed only from grant counters.

event_id.description: Origin occurrence identity; background requests retain their own IDs.

service_round_index.description: Frozen accounting round charged for this chunk.

transport_host_id.description: Host emitting the data-path service observation.

transport_clock_id.description: Local monotonic clock identity for this observation.

payload_offset_start.description: Inclusive offset into the unique encoded payload.

payload_offset_end.description: Exclusive offset; conservation auditor detects duplicate ranges and holes.

observed_payload_bytes.description: Bytes actually observed at the specified data-path point.

charged_unique_service.description: Apply exactly the frozen application-byte accounting semantics; duplicate wire retransmission stays separate.

application_wire_bytes.description: Application wire count if measured; not NIC/Wi-Fi airtime.

core_queued_complete_jobs.description: Observed complete jobs waiting at decision.

core_job_state_digest.description: Digest of retained job IDs and causally estimated remaining costs.

remaining_application_budget_bytes.description: Budget remaining at this point in the actual service round.

calibration_sha256.description: Independent frozen calibration used for estimates; never current event future timings.

estimate_inputs_raw_record_ids.description: Only state observed by decision time; source audit must verify causality.

predicted_result_slack_ns_by_event.description: Prediction only. Do not replace observed result timing with this value.

started_utc.description: Wall-clock provenance only; not used for cross-host latency subtraction.

retry_of_attempt_id.description: Earlier complete attempt, if a predeclared infrastructure retry was permitted.

exclusion_reason_code.description: Only a preregistered independent infrastructure reason; timing/cap/detection outcomes are never exclusion reasons.

plan_sha256.description: Exact plan used before this attempt.

formal_freeze_sha256.description: Required for formal phase; calibration/pilot use their own separately frozen records.

raw_archive_manifest_sha256.description: Final raw capture manifest; null if not yet finalized.

x-cross-record-invariants: All planned/generated new occurrences are accounted for exactly once in the final normalized event ledger; all attempts retained.
Queue_before + new_admitted - cancelled_from_queue - actual_unique_application_service = queue_after for each probe/service period.
Sum actual unique application service across all probes in a round <= shared_cap_bytes; reconstruct from primitive chunks independently of grant/violation flags.
Unique payload offsets cover received/sent bytes without hiding duplicate wire transmissions; complete payload = received_unique + queued + inflight + discarded under the frozen accounting point.
Result latency subtracts only result_received_origin_ns - actual_event_creation_origin_ns on one origin_clock_id; nominal sensitivity substitutes scheduled_release_origin_ns on that same clock.
Core wait and inference durations use only core_clock_id; never subtract core timestamps from origin timestamps without validated clock alignment and error bounds.
Missing unmatured results remain pending/censored; do not convert them silently into definitive misses or successes. All-generated timely-output denominators retain rejected and missing requests.
First measured batch and all-measured strata are fixed in the plan before outcomes. Background requests are separate from new generated denominators.
Admission uses state observable by decision_time, frozen calibration and actual remaining service/core work; no post-event measured times as current decision inputs.
